summary: Context recheck of PT9L design transfer and design output list approval fields confirms blank submission/review/approval date fields in the design output list, no retrievable design transfer record or ECO/approval routing record in the supplied evidence catalog, and a process instruction referencing EBOM by document number without version pinning and without a visible approval signature block in the supplied evidence.
review_notes: DMR-043 (F0160) is the primary design output list (设计输出清单一) and is the only design output index document with visible header fields in the supplied evidence; a second design output list (设计输出清单二, folder F0161–F0173) exists as a collection of individual BOM and drawing files but no consolidated index sheet with approval fields was retrieved.
DMR-024 (F0155) confirms the process instruction document number is PT9L-GYSM01 V1.0; the process instruction content is in DMR-018 through DMR-023 (F0154/F0155).
DMR-032 through DMR-037 (F0157) confirm the EBOM document number is PT9L-EBOM01 V1.0; the EBOM itself carries a version identifier in its header.

No design transfer record (设计转换记录 / PT9L-SJSC01) appears in the supplied evidence catalog for this run; the assignment_id ASG-0012 requested retrieval of PT9L-SJSC01 but no evidence entry with that document number is present in the provided evidence_catalog.
No ECO records, design review meeting minutes, or approval routing records appear in the supplied evidence catalog.

Drawing PT9L-F01 is used as the drawing number for both the outer-carton drawing (DMR-068, F0164) and the appearance drawing (DMR-138, F0177); this collision was flagged in RUN-0005 and is confirmed by the current evidence.

The packaging BOM in F0161 (DMR-049) uses document number PT9L-PBOM01 V1.0 while F0162 (DMR-056/DMR-057) uses PT9L-PB0M1 V1.0 (zero substituted for letter O); both files list the same part numbers and quantities, suggesting they are the same document with a typographic variant in the document number.

The instruction manual drawing number in F0161 (DMR-052) is listed as PT9L-SMSPO1 (letter O at end) while F0162 (DMR-060) lists it as PT9L-SMSP01 (numeral 1 at end); the drawing itself (DMR-089, F0167) confirms the correct number is PT9L-SMSP01 V1.0.

PT3-origin drawings (DMR-129 to DMR-134, F0176) and a supplier drawing (DMR-117 to DMR-122, F0174) are archived in the PT9L DHF design output folder without a cross-product justification document in the supplied evidence.
The T040800073941030093-PT3-F21 drawing (DMR-108 to DMR-113, F0172) has '待填' (to be filled) placeholders in both the Drawing NO. and Pro material fields, indicating an incomplete drawing record.

findings.claim: The design output list (PT9L-设计输出清单一) carries blank submission date, review date, and approval date fields, and no separate approval routing record, ECO record, or design review minutes exist in the supplied evidence catalog to serve as substitute approval evidence.
findings.rationale: DMR-043 (F0160, line 10) shows the header row: '产品型号: PT9L 提交部门:智能产品部 提交: 年 月 日 审核: 年 月 日' — the date fields after '提交:', '审核:' are unpopulated (only '年 月 日' placeholders remain). No approval field is visible at all. No ECO record, design review meeting minutes, or approval routing record appears anywhere in the supplied evidence catalog. The design transfer record PT9L-SJSC01, explicitly requested in ASG-0012, is absent from the evidence catalog. This means the formal sign-off chain for the primary design output index cannot be confirmed as complete from the supplied evidence.
challenge_questions: Can the responsible engineer produce a signed and dated copy of the design output list (PT9L-设计输出清单一) with all three fields (提交, 审核, 批准) populated?
Does a design transfer record (PT9L-SJSC01) exist in the document management system, and if so, why is it absent from the DHF package submitted for audit?
Are there design review meeting minutes or an ECO record that formally approved the design output list contents, and can these be produced as substitute approval evidence?
Is the blank-date condition a systemic document-control gap or was the design output list approved through an electronic workflow system whose records are not included in this DHF package?

findings.claim: No design transfer record (PT9L-SJSC01 or equivalent) is present in the supplied evidence catalog, leaving the formal design-to-production transfer step unverifiable from the DHF package.
findings.rationale: ASG-0012 explicitly requested retrieval of PT9L-SJSC01 as the design transfer record. No evidence entry with document number PT9L-SJSC01 or any document titled '设计转换' or '设计转移' appears in the 140-entry evidence catalog provided. The process instruction (DMR-024, F0155, PT9L-GYSM01 V1.0) and EBOM (DMR-032, F0157, PT9L-EBOM01 V1.0) exist, but without a transfer record linking design outputs to production inputs, the closed-loop transfer cannot be confirmed.
challenge_questions: Has a design transfer record (PT9L-SJSC01) been created and approved? If yes, why is it not included in the DHF package?
What document or record formally authorizes the transition from design output to production use of PT9L-GYSM01 and PT9L-EBOM01?
Is there a production release record or manufacturing authorization that substitutes for a formal design transfer record in this quality system?

findings.claim: The process instruction (PT9L-GYSM01 V1.0) references the EBOM as 'PT9L机芯类组件清单 PT9L-EBOM01 (按照最新版本执行)' — directing operators to use the latest version rather than pinning a specific version — and no approval signature block is visible in the supplied evidence for this instruction.
findings.rationale: DMR-021 (F0154, line 16) states: '元件使用参考 PT9L机芯类组件清单 PT9L-EBOM01 (按照最新版本执行)'. The phrase '按照最新版本执行' (execute per latest version) means the process instruction does not lock to a specific EBOM version. If the EBOM is revised, operators would automatically use the new version without a corresponding process instruction change or re-approval, breaking the controlled document chain. The process instruction header (DMR-024, F0155) shows document number PT9L-GYSM01 V1.0 but no approval signature fields are visible in the supplied evidence text.
challenge_questions: Why does the process instruction direct operators to use the 'latest version' of the EBOM rather than citing a specific approved version?
If the EBOM is revised to V2.0, what change control mechanism ensures the process instruction is reviewed and re-approved before the new EBOM version is used in production?
Does the process instruction PT9L-GYSM01 V1.0 carry a signed approval block in the document management system, and can it be produced?
Is there a document control procedure that permits 'latest version' references in process instructions, and has it been validated for this product?

findings.claim: Drawing number PT9L-F01 is assigned to two distinct physical items — the outer carton (F0164) and the product appearance drawing (F0177) — creating an unresolvable document-control ambiguity in the design output package.
findings.rationale: DMR-068 (F0164, line 20) shows '| **Drawing NO.** | PT9L-F01 |' for the outer carton drawing. DMR-138 (F0177, line 14) shows '| **Drawing NO.** | **PT9L-F01**（⚠️ 与外箱 PT9L-F01 同号但不同件）|' for the product appearance drawing, with the reading agent itself flagging the collision. Two different physical items sharing the same drawing number violates basic document control requirements and makes it impossible to unambiguously reference the correct drawing in assembly instructions, inspection records, or the BOM.
challenge_questions: How did two distinct drawings (outer carton and product appearance) come to share the drawing number PT9L-F01?
Which drawing number is correct for each item, and has a corrective action been initiated to assign unique numbers?
Are there any assembly instructions, inspection records, or BOM entries that reference PT9L-F01 where the ambiguity could cause a production or inspection error?
Has this collision been captured in the corrective action or document change system?

findings.claim: Two packaging BOM files for the same PT9L US-market product carry different document numbers (PT9L-PBOM01 V1.0 in F0161 vs. PT9L-PB0M1 V1.0 in F0162, with a zero/letter-O substitution), and the instruction manual part number differs between the two files (PT9L-SMSPO1 in F0161 vs. PT9L-SMSP01 in F0162), creating an unresolved document identity conflict.
findings.rationale: DMR-049 (F0161, line 8) shows 'PT9L-P BOM01 V1.0' (with space, likely OCR artifact of PT9L-PBOM01). DMR-056/DMR-057 (F0162, lines 8 and 10) show 'PT9L-PB0M1 V1.0' (zero in place of O, and digit 1 at end vs. 01). DMR-052 (F0161, line 23) lists the instruction manual part number as 'PT9L-SMSPO1' (letter O at end). DMR-060 (F0162, line 16) lists it as 'PT9L-SMSP01' (numeral 1 at end). The drawing itself (DMR-089, F0167) confirms 'PT9L-SMSP01 V1.0' as the correct number. These discrepancies indicate at least one of the two BOM files contains typographic errors that have not been corrected through a formal document change.
challenge_questions: Which packaging BOM file (F0161 or F0162) is the controlled master, and has the other been superseded or voided?
Has the typographic error in the document number (zero vs. letter O) been captured in the document management system as a known variant or as an error requiring correction?
Is the instruction manual part number PT9L-SMSP01 or PT9L-SMSPO1, and has the incorrect entry in F0161 been corrected through a formal change record?
Are there any purchase orders, incoming inspection records, or production records that used the incorrect part number, and if so, have those records been reviewed?

findings.claim: The packaging label drawing T040800073941030093-PT3-F21 (F0172) has '待填' (to be filled) placeholders in both the Drawing NO. and Pro material fields, indicating the drawing record is incomplete and has not been finalized in the DHF.
findings.rationale: DMR-112 (F0172, line 20) shows '| **Drawing NO.** | （待填 - 见右下标题栏） |' and DMR-113 (F0172, line 22) shows '| **Pro material** | （待填） |'. A drawing with unfilled title-block fields cannot serve as a controlled design output. The file name references 'PT3-F21', suggesting this may be a PT3-origin shared component drawing, but no cross-product justification document is present in the supplied evidence.
challenge_questions: Has the drawing T040800073941030093-PT3-F21 been finalized with a confirmed drawing number and material specification?
Is this drawing a PT3 shared component being used in PT9L, and if so, where is the documented justification for its inclusion in the PT9L DHF?
Is this drawing referenced in any PT9L BOM or assembly instruction, and if so, how is the incomplete title block managed in production?
What is the approval status of this drawing in the document management system?

findings.claim: Two drawings originating from the PT3 project (PT3_双联弹簧_REV01, drawing number PT3-P10, model PT3; and FDIR-V14_散热器压块_REV01_0714, mapped to PT3-M01 in the PT9L BOM) are archived in the PT9L DHF design output folder without any cross-product shared-component justification document in the supplied evidence catalog.
findings.rationale: DMR-133 (F0176, line 14) shows Drawing NO. PT3-P10. DMR-134 (F0176, line 17) explicitly states 'Model NO.: PT3（注：归档于 PT9L DHF，实为 PT3 项目原件）'. DMR-126 (F0175, line 28) maps the 散热器压块 drawing to PT3-M01 in the PT9L BOM. DMR-132 (F0176, line 6) notes this is a 'PT3 项目原件，被 PT9L DHF 借用归档（外购件 / 设计参照）'. No shared-component agreement, design reuse justification, or equivalence assessment document appears in the supplied evidence catalog.
challenge_questions: Is there a formal shared-component or design reuse agreement that authorizes the use of PT3-origin drawings (PT3-P10, PT3-M01) in the PT9L DHF?
Have the PT3-origin components been verified as fit-for-purpose for PT9L, and where is that verification record?
Are the PT3-origin components identical to those used in PT9L production, or have there been any modifications that would require a PT9L-specific drawing revision?
Does the PT9L EBOM (PT9L-EBOM01 V1.0) correctly reference these components with their PT3 drawing numbers, and has this been reviewed during design transfer?
